description: This bar chart illustrates the percentage gain in performance for several language models under different levels of supervision. The horizontal axis displays the model names: “Claude-3.5-Sonnet”, “Qwen2-72B-Chat”, and “Qwen-72B”, listed alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “Percentage Gain (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at 5-unit intervals. Two bars are present for each model, representing “Strong Supervision” and “Weak Supervision”, displayed in darker and lighter shades of purple, respectively. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the “Strong Supervision” bar reaches approximately 28%, while the “Weak Supervision” bar reaches approximately 14%. For Qwen2-72B-Chat, the “Strong Supervision” bar reaches approximately 18%, and the “Weak Supervision” bar reaches approximately 8%. Finally, for Qwen-72B, the “Strong Supervision” bar reaches approximately 16%, and the “Weak Supervision” bar reaches approximately 6%. The bars are grouped by model, with the “Strong Supervision” bar positioned to the left and the “Weak Supervision” bar to the right within each group. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
